7.  Oral Communications or Items not on the Agenda

  Community member Mr. Jackson has observed kids near the trails and the youth
  response kindly to the equestrian community as they pass by.  Mr. Jackson  did
  recommend  due to the increase volume of electronic bicycles on the trails to
  have an outreach program created for organizations and community on
  educating the groups on how to be around horses.

  Chair Pasillas commented on the 2026 Committee and if there are any concerns
  with a possible drone show near the equestrian center  Mr. Jackson stated that
  there are no major concerns as long as the drowns are flown high.
